note: On 9 February 1903 the Council passed 'A recommendation, ordinance and estimate for curbing, grading and paving with asphalt Prairie avenue, from 16th street to 20th street' (p. 2067, 67 yeas to 2). Its title names curbing and does not name a 'combined curb and gutter', which in the same months' titles is named whenever it is ordered.
what_it_supplies: the ordinance under which Prairie Avenue from 16th to 20th Street was curbed and paved with asphalt in 1903
what_it_does_not_supply: the curb's material, which the printed title does not state
